name: Gamma
summary: Turns a prompt or rough notes into a deck, document or webpage draft. Output still needs a human pass for high-stakes decks.
best_for: anyone who wants to turn a prompt or notes into a good-looking presentation, doc or webpage draft in minutes
skip_if: you need pixel-perfect, brand-controlled decks — you'll spend the saved time re-polishing the AI output
honest_knock: The credit model means heavy generation eats your monthly allowance, and outputs still need a human polish for high-stakes decks — it's a brilliant first-draft engine, not a finished-deck button. The free tier's watermark pushes you to paid quickly.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-29 in a rendered browser that got past the bot challenge: the individual plans are unchanged from our 16 and 26 August readings, the business side is not. Served to us in euros from a Dutch address, so your own checkout may quote dollars) Free €0 with 400 one-time credits at signup and up to 10 slides per generation. These are the individual plans, monthly / annual per seat per month. Plus is €10 / €8 with 1,000 monthly credits and Gamma branding removed. Pro is €24 / €18 with 4,000 credits, API access and up to 10 custom domains. Ultra is €86 / €77.33 with 20,000 credits and the most advanced models. Read the annual column carefully: that €77.33 is not a rate Gamma charges but €928 a seat a year divided by twelve, and the same arithmetic sits behind €8 and €18. On the business side the page now lists only Business, at €35 per seat a month billed annually (€420 a year) with 10,000 credits per seat, shared workspace credits and SSO, and Enterprise on a custom annual agreement; the Team plan (€18 a seat, 6,000 credits) that stood beside it in August is gone. Annual billing is advertised as saving up to 25%, and unused credits roll over up to twice the monthly allowance.

sessions.what: On 28 September 2026 we gave Gamma, Beautiful.ai, Prezi and Canva the same brief for a ten-slide investor deck: eleven facts about a made-up bakery chain and the rule to add no other numbers. We checked every deck against 15 tests written down before the first one was generated. Gamma ran on a new Free account.
findings: Gamma asked us to pick a style, then its outline pane stayed empty until we wrote 'Please draft the outline.'; the finished deck was ready about seven minutes after the prompt.
It added no numbers of its own, kept both charts to scale and marked the missing market figures as [MARKET SIZE] and [COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE]. It left out the founding year.

Asked once to 'Change the ask to €450,000 for 12%', it updated all three places the amount appeared and showed the old and new slide side by side. It was the only one of the four to change the deck completely from one prompt.

The deck and the change used 61 of the 400 starting credits. PDF and PowerPoint export work on Free; the text stays editable, the charts arrive as pictures, and every PDF page carries a 'Made with Gamma' badge.
sessions.not_tested: One run on one day on the Free plan. We did not judge design quality, and the logged-out share test was blocked by a bot check on Gamma's side, so it is not tested.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
